column3: “Over the thirty” is rendered “had charge of thirty”; NASB supplies “over.”
The written text is shortened here; NASB reads “Benjamites,” following the form read aloud.
“Chief” is rendered “chief officer”; NASB supplies “in charge of.”
“Did not take their number” is rendered “did not count”; NASB supplies “He would.”
NASB supplies “them.” “Did not go up in the number of the words of the days” is rendered “was not included in the account of the chronicles.”
“Over” is rendered “had charge of,” and “the open country” as “the country.”
“Over the doers of the work of the field for the labor of the ground” is rendered “had charge of the agricultural workers who tilled the soil.”
“That which was in the vineyards to the storehouses of the wine” is rendered “the produce of the vineyards stored in the wine cellars.”
NASB reads “Shitrai,” the name read aloud, for the written “Shirtai.”
